lang.name: English
app.title: AI Image Lab
app.subtitle: Describe a picture and watch AI create it.
login.message: Enter the username and password you got from the supervisor.
create.label: What would you like to create?
create.placeholder.1: A cat riding a skateboard in Gothenburg
create.placeholder.2: A candy house in a snowy forest
create.placeholder.3: A robot fishing at a lake
ideas.title: Pick an idea
ideas.hint: Tap a picture to put its description in the box. Then tap Create image, or change the text first.
helper.heading: Need help with your idea?
helper.hint: Pick an example, improve your text or get an idea.
helper.failed: I couldn't come up with anything just now. Try again!
edit.refused: That change didn't work out. Try another one!
ideas.example_note: This is an example picture. Change the description and tap Create image to get your own.
style.heading: Pick a style (optional)
chips.heading: Change your picture
chips.hint: Tap and AI changes your picture.
footer.privacy: Images and descriptions are not stored by the app.
how.intro: AI Image Lab is not just one AI. It is a system where many parts work together, and the language model is only one of them. Tap **Next step** and follow your picture through the system.
how.prompt.title: Your text
how.prompt.text: You write what you want to see. That is the only thing that comes from you.
how.translate.title: Translation
how.translate.text: Image models understand English best. A language model, the kind behind a chatbot, translates your text into English.
how.style.title: Style
how.style.text: The style you picked is added as extra words, for example "oil painting". This is plain code, no AI.
how.check.title: Text check
how.check.text: The finished text is read by a filter and by a language model that knows the workshop rules. If anything is unsuitable it stops here, before any picture is made.
how.limits.title: Limits
how.limits.text: The app checks that not too many pictures are made too fast and that the budget is enough. This is plain code with counters.
how.image.title: Image model
how.image.text: The text is sent to an image model. It draws a brand new picture from patterns it learned in training. It does not search the web or copy an image.
how.review.title: Image check
how.review.text: The finished picture is reviewed by a filter before you see it. If anything is unsuitable it is never shown.
how.result.title: Your picture
how.result.text: The picture is shown to you and is not stored by the app. The buttons under it send it to an image model that can edit pictures, and then through the image check again.
error.timeout: The image service didn't respond in time. Please try again.
error.busy: Lots of people are creating images right now. Try again in a moment.
error.cooldown: Please wait a moment before creating the next image.
error.budget: Today's image budget has been reached. Thanks for trying AI Image Lab!
error.paused: Image creation is paused for a little while.
error.safety: That idea isn't suitable for this workshop. Try another one!
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.empty: Write what you want to create first.
error.too_long: That description is too long. Please make it a bit shorter.
